metadata.description: Document requirements for Bangladeshi CS/AI/ML students applying to study abroad 2027-2029
metadata.targetProfile: Bangladeshi student, BSc completed, applying for MSc/PhD in CS/AI/ML/Data Science
metadata.criticalNote: Document preparation should begin 12-18 months before application deadline. Bangladeshi students face additional attestation and verification steps not required for other nationalities.

requiredDocuments.details: All semester marksheets from BSc. Must be attested by university and Ministry of Education Bangladesh.
Original degree or provisional certificate. Notarized copy required.
IELTS 6.5+ overall (no band below 6.0) or TOEFL iBT 90+. Some universities accept Duolingo.
Optional at most Canadian universities but recommended for competitive programs. 315+ preferred.
750-1000 words. Must specifically address research interests matching faculty.
2-3 academic references. Must be from faculty who taught or supervised research. Direct email submission preferred.
Academic format. Include research, publications, projects, GPA.
Valid minimum 2 years beyond program end date.

visaDocuments.details: Applied online via IRCC portal after receiving Letter of Acceptance.
From Designated Learning Institution (DLI). Required before visa application.
CAD 20,635/year minimum for living costs plus tuition. Bank statement last 6 months. Scholarship letter if funded.
Required for Bangladesh passport holders. Collected at VFS Global Dhaka.
Required for study permits over 6 months. Designated IRCC physician only.
From Bangladesh Police. Required for visa and study permit.
Why Canada, why this program, intent to return - though PR is the actual goal, official statement must show study intent.

bangladeshSpecificSteps: Transcripts must be attested by university registrar, then Ministry of Education, then Ministry of Foreign Affairs
Degree certificate requires same attestation chain
VFS Global Dhaka office handles biometric collection
Bank statement should show steady balance not sudden deposits
Scholarship offer letter significantly strengthens financial proof

requiredDocuments.details: Official transcripts from BSc institution. Australian universities may require certified copies.
Original or certified copy. Must show completed qualification.
IELTS 6.5+ overall (6.0 per band) or TOEFL iBT 79+ or PTE 58+.
For PhD: detailed research proposal 1,500-3,000 words aligned with supervisor. For MSc: SOP 500-800 words.
2-3 academic referees. Direct online submission via university portal.
Academic and professional achievements. Include any publications or research projects.

visaDocuments.details: Applied via ImmiAccount online portal.
Issued by university after accepting offer and paying deposit.
Replaced GTE from 2024. Must demonstrate genuine study intention and understanding of program.
AUD 29,710/year living costs + tuition. Bank statements, scholarship letter, or sponsor declaration.
Overseas Student Health Cover mandatory for entire visa duration. Must purchase before visa lodgement.
Required for Bangladesh nationals. Via BUPA Medical or panel physician.
May be required. Collected at VFS Global Dhaka.
Bangladesh Police clearance certificate.

bangladeshSpecificSteps: Transcripts and degree must be certified - Australian universities may specify apostille or notarization
GSR statement must be genuine and specific - vague answers cause refusal
OSHC must be purchased from approved provider before visa lodgement
Financial documents must show stable funds not recent lump sum deposits

keyDeadlines.visaApplyAfterCoE: Apply within 2 weeks of CoE receipt

estimatedCosts.biometricFee: AUD 0 if included in visa fee

requiredDocuments.details: All semester transcripts with grades. Must be officially certified. Many universities require APS certificate for Bangladeshi applicants.
Akademische Pruefungsstelle certificate. Required for Bangladeshi students applying to German universities. Involves interview and document verification at German Embassy Dhaka.
Certified copy with certified German or English translation.
For English-taught programs: IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 90+. German programs require TestDaF 4 or DSH-2.
Why this program, why Germany, research interests. 500-800 words.
2 academic references. Some universities accept directly uploaded PDF.
Standard European CV format preferred.

visaDocuments.details: Applied at German Embassy Dhaka. Required before departure.
Conditional or unconditional admission required.
EUR 11,208/year minimum (2025-2026 rate). Must open before visa application. Fintiba or Coracle recommended.
German public health insurance proof or equivalent. TK or AOK student plans.
visaDocuments.processingTime: Can arrange after arrival for first month

visaDocuments.details: Student dormitory booking, rental contract, or host declaration.
Required for the visa application as well.
visaDocuments.processingTime: Must be completed before visa application

bangladeshSpecificSteps: APS certificate is mandatory and the most time-consuming step - begin this first
All documents in German must be translated by certified sworn translator
Blocked account is essential - no exceptions for visa
German Embassy Dhaka appointment may have waiting time of 4-8 weeks
German language learning recommended to start immediately even for English programs

keyDeadlines.apsCertificateLeadTime: Begin APS process 6 months before application deadline

requiredDocuments.details: Official transcripts from all years of BSc. Certified copies required.
IELTS 6.5+ overall or TOEFL iBT 90+. Some universities accept PTE or Duolingo.
Why Ireland, why this program, career goals. 500-800 words.
From university professors or research supervisors.
Academic and technical projects highlighted.

visaDocuments.details: Applied online via AVATS system. Ireland uses permission letter not traditional visa sticker for studies.
From Irish university. Required before visa application.
EUR 10,000 minimum for first year living costs plus tuition fees. Bank statement 6 months.
Required for visa. Irish Life Health or Laya Healthcare student plans.
Bangladesh Police clearance. Must be recent within 6 months.

bangladeshSpecificSteps: Ireland visa process via AVATS online - straightforward but funds proof very important
Must register with GNIB (Garda National Immigration Bureau) within 90 days of arrival
IRP (Irish Residence Permit) card collected after registration - essential document
Housing in Dublin must be arranged before arrival - market very tight

requiredDocuments.details: Certified copies of all BSc transcripts. Dutch universities may require Nuffic credential evaluation.
IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL iBT 90+. Applied Science universities may accept lower.
Specific to program and university. Research interest alignment important.
Academic references submitted via university portal.
Standard European format.

visaDocuments.details: Required before departure. Applied at Dutch Embassy - Dhaka handles via third country embassy or VFS.
Required for MVV application.
EUR 11,000-13,000/year living costs. Bank statement or scholarship letter.
Police clearance from Bangladesh.
AON or SMP student insurance required before or shortly after arrival.

bangladeshSpecificSteps: Check Dutch Embassy coverage for Bangladesh - may need to apply through third-country embassy
University typically assists with MVV and residence permit process
BSN (citizen service number) registration at municipality essential after arrival
Housing must be arranged before arrival - extremely competitive in Amsterdam and Utrecht

requiredDocuments.details: All BSc transcripts uploaded to universityadmissions.se portal.
IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL iBT 90+. Swedish universities specify per program.
Certified copy uploaded digitally.
Program specific. 500-700 words.
2 academic references. Contact details submitted; university may contact directly.

visaDocuments.details: Applied online via Migrationsverket before departure. No separate visa for non-EU students.
From universityadmissions.se and the specific university.
SEK 8,514/month minimum (2025 rate). Bank statements or scholarship documentation.
Required for first period before Swedish personal number obtained.
Valid throughout study period. Biometric passport required.

bangladeshSpecificSteps: Apply through universityadmissions.se central portal - single application for multiple universities
Migrationsverket online application is straightforward but financial proof must be specific
Apply for Swedish personal number at Tax Agency after arrival - enables bank account, healthcare
Tuition fees apply for non-EU students - check if program has scholarship automatically

keyDeadlines.permitApply: Apply as soon as acceptance received

requiredDocuments.details: Official transcripts. Finnish universities may require credential recognition from Finnish National Agency for Education (FINNA).
IELTS 6.0-6.5 or TOEFL 90+. Varies by university and program.
Certified copy.
500-800 words. Research alignment critical for funded positions.
2 academic references.

visaDocuments.details: Applied via Enter Finland online portal. No visa required separately for non-EU if permit obtained.
From Finnish university.
EUR 560/month minimum (EUR 6,720/year). Bank statement or scholarship letter.
Required until Finnish municipality registration obtained.

bangladeshSpecificSteps: Enter Finland portal is user-friendly - biometric permit collected from Migrationsverket office in Helsinki after arrival
Register at local DigitaalinenFinland or DVV after arrival for Finnish ID
Tuition fees apply for non-EU - scholarships at Aalto, Helsinki, Tampere important to secure
Finnish language courses available free - begin immediately for long-term integration

requiredDocuments.details: Certified official transcripts. ENIC/NARIC Denmark credential evaluation may be required.
IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL iBT 83+. DTU and KU specify per program.
Specific research interest and program fit. 500-700 words.
Academic referees.
Academic focus with technical skills and projects.

visaDocuments.details: Applied online via newtodenmark.dk before departure.
Required for permit application.
DKK 6,243/month (approx EUR 840). Bank statements or scholarship confirmation.
Required until Danish CPR number obtained and public health access granted.
Bangladesh national police certificate.

bangladeshSpecificSteps: newtodenmark.dk application is online and accessible
CPR registration essential after arrival - enables health, banking, everything
Tuition fees for non-EU outside scholarship - check DTU PhD funded positions
Danish integration contract may apply after PR stage

requiredDocuments.details: Certified official transcripts. NOKUT credential recognition for Bangladeshi degrees.
IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 90+. Norwegian universities accept both.
500-800 words program specific.
Academic referees.
Academic and research focus.

visaDocuments.details: Applied via UDI (Norwegian Directorate of Immigration) online portal.
From Norwegian university.
NOK 137,907/year (2025 rate). Bank statement or scholarship/funding confirmation.
Bangladesh national police certificate.

bangladeshSpecificSteps: Norway has no tuition fees at public universities even for non-EU - key advantage
Financial proof requirement is higher than most EU countries due to Norwegian cost of living
UDI online application straightforward
Register at local Folkeregisteret after arrival for national ID number (fødselsnummer)

requiredDocuments.details: Certified official transcripts. ETH and EPFL require very high GPA - typically 3.7+ equivalent.
IELTS 7.0+ or TOEFL 100+ for ETH Zurich and EPFL. Very competitive threshold.
Often required for ETH and EPFL particularly for PhD. 320+ competitive.
For PhD: 1,500-3,000 words. Must align precisely with supervisor research.
Strong references from research supervisors critical. Generic references not sufficient.
Research publications, projects, competition achievements. Quality over quantity.

visaDocuments.details: Applied at Swiss Embassy. Bangladesh covered via Swiss Embassy New Delhi or VFS.
From ETH, EPFL, or Swiss university.
CHF 21,000/year minimum. Bank statements or funding letter from university.
Swiss mandatory health insurance (KVG/LAMal). Must purchase within 3 months of arrival.
Rental contract or university housing confirmation.

bangladeshSpecificSteps: Swiss Embassy for Bangladesh is in New Delhi - apply well in advance
ETH and EPFL acceptance rates very low globally - apply to 6-8 universities as backup
PhD positions at ETH typically fully funded with salary - this is the target pathway
Register at Einwohnerkontrolle (residents registration) within 14 days of arrival
Swiss health insurance is mandatory and expensive - budget CHF 300-400/month

requiredDocuments.details: Official transcripts from BSc university. Many US universities require WES or ECE credential evaluation for Bangladeshi degrees.
World Education Services evaluation. Required by most US universities for Bangladeshi transcripts. Course-by-course evaluation recommended.
Required by many top CS programs. 320+ for top 50 universities. Some programs waiving GRE since 2022.
TOEFL iBT 100+ or IELTS 7.0+ for top programs. Some accept 90/6.5.
Most critical document. 800-1,200 words. Research-focused. Must name specific faculty.
Strong academic references essential. Research supervisors preferred over coursework professors.
Publications, research, projects, competitions. Quality critical for top programs.
Some programs require research paper or technical writing sample.
requiredDocuments.processingTime: Use existing research paper if available

visaDocuments.details: Applied at US Embassy Dhaka after receiving I-20 form from university.
Issued by SEVIS-registered university after paying SEVIS fee.
USD 350 fee paid online before visa interview.
Online visa application form. Must be completed before interview.
Full first year costs. Funding letter from university or personal/sponsor bank statements.
US Embassy Dhaka conducts F-1 interviews. High refusal rate for Bangladeshi applicants without strong funding. Funded PhD/MS positions significantly reduce refusal risk.
I-20, offer of admission, funding letter all required at interview.

bangladeshSpecificSteps: WES evaluation is critical - begin this 5-6 months before application deadline
F-1 visa refusal rate for Bangladesh nationals is higher than average - funded admission dramatically improves chances
Strong ties to Bangladesh or convincing study purpose required for consular officer
Contact professors directly before applying - response from professor dramatically improves admission chances
Apply to range of programs: 2-3 reach, 3-4 target, 2-3 safety

requiredDocuments.details: Certified official transcripts. Japanese universities may require certified Japanese translation.
IELTS 6.0+ or TOEFL 79+ for English programs. JLPT N2 or N1 for Japanese language programs.
For graduate school: detailed research plan required. Must contact professor before applying - essential in Japanese system.
Most critical document. Without lab acceptance from professor, formal application has very low chance. Email professors 6-12 months before.
Academic referees. One may be the accepting Japanese professor.
If applying for MEXT scholarship - additional forms, interview, and timeline via Japanese Embassy Dhaka.

visaDocuments.details: Certificate of Eligibility (COE) obtained by university first, then visa at Japanese Embassy Dhaka.
University applies on student behalf at local immigration. Required before visa application.
JPY 120,000-150,000/month. Scholarship letter or bank statements.
Medical examination form required by some universities.

bangladeshSpecificSteps: Professor contact is the single most important step - without this admission is very unlikely
MEXT Embassy scholarship via Japanese Embassy Dhaka - applications open around April each year
Japanese language learning should start immediately - even N4 is appreciated
COE process handled by university - student must wait and be patient
Budget carefully - Tokyo is expensive but MEXT covers living allowance

requiredDocuments.details: Official certified transcripts. Korean universities may require apostille or notarization.
requiredDocuments.processingTime: Translation to Korean or English 2-4 weeks

requiredDocuments.details: IELTS 6.0+ or TOEFL 80+ for English programs. TOPIK Level 4+ for Korean language programs.
PhD required. MSc recommended. Contact professor in advance similar to Japan.
Email Korean professors before formal application. Lab acceptance important for PhD.
Academic referees.
If applying for Korean Government Scholarship (GKS) - separate application via Korean Embassy Dhaka.

visaDocuments.details: Applied at Korean Embassy Dhaka after university admission.
From KAIST, SNU, POSTECH or other Korean university.
USD 600/month living expenses. Bank statements or scholarship letter.
Bangladesh not Hague Convention member - use notarization and embassy legalization chain.

bangladeshSpecificSteps: Bangladesh not Hague apostille member - documents need notarization then Korean Embassy Dhaka legalization
GKS scholarship via Korean Embassy - significant funding opportunity, apply annually
Korean language TOPIK exam registration - start Korean from day one
ARC (Alien Registration Card) mandatory within 90 days of arrival
KAIST and POSTECH are fully funded for PhD - target these specifically

requiredDocuments.details: Certified official transcripts with English translation.
Notarized copy with certified translation.
IELTS 6.0+ or TOEFL 80+ for English programs. HSK Level 4+ for Chinese language programs.
500-800 words describing research intentions.
Academic recommendation letters.
Chinese Government Scholarship via CSC portal. Very competitive. Apply via Chinese Embassy Dhaka.
Foreigner physical exam form required for X visa and residence permit.
requiredDocuments.processingTime: Complete at designated hospital in China

visaDocuments.details: For studies over 180 days. Applied at Chinese Embassy Dhaka.
Chinese government scholarship or self-funded admission form issued by university via education ministry.
From Chinese university. Must include JW form.
CNY 3,000-5,000/month. Bank statements or CSC scholarship letter.
Must apply within 30 days of arrival at local PSB Exit-Entry Administration.

bangladeshSpecificSteps: CSC scholarship is the primary funding route - apply through Chinese Embassy Dhaka each year
VPN situation must be understood before arrival - professional and academic connectivity affected
Physical examination required in China within weeks of arrival
Residence permit registration at PSB mandatory
HSK Chinese language exam recommended to start immediately for long-term career
